title: 第150章 屈辱第149章 死变态
lines: 楚生看着对方洋洋得意的眼神，并没有感受到对方的杀意。
大丈夫，能屈能伸。
不就是受点委屈吗？
算个屁！
于是乎，楚生深吸一口气，和善道：“姑娘，是我错了！”
“是我不该随地脱衣服，这样你看可以了吗？”
女子这才将腿放下来，得意道：“这还差不多！”
“看你态度诚恳，我就勉为其难原谅你吧！”
“所以，我可以穿衣服了吗？”
楚生低声道，语气尽是不服。
女子也没管他，还是自顾自地走到火堆旁，坐了下来。
楚生孤零零地穿着衣服，看起来十分卑微。
然后，楚生回到火堆旁，不满道：“这位姑娘，你这是不打算走了吗？”
女子抬起头，水灵灵的眼睛看向楚生，顿时可爱无比。
若不是被对方一招打得飙血，他还真会被对方的模样所迷惑。
女子看到楚生冰冷的脸，手中抛出一个玉瓶，孤傲道：“死变态，不就是打了你一顿吗？”
“一个大男人，能不能不要这么小气？”
“这瓶丹药，够你回复气血了，就当做是我赔罪了！”
楚生接过玉瓶，一打开盖子，便蹿出一股丹药的香味，令人气血沸腾。
三品丹药，回血丹！
楚生咧嘴一笑，道：“多谢姑娘，要不你再打我一顿？”
女子一脸嫌弃道：“青云学院的弟子，就这么没骨气吗？”
“骨气，能当饭吃吗？”
楚生反驳道，“而且，你真打算留在我这里？”
“这地方是你的吗？”
女子气势不减，方才打人的架势瞬间起来。
楚生肩头一缩，道：“算了，这地方给你吧！”
“你不走，我走！”
楚生说罢，便直接转身。
虽然这个女子对自己没有杀心，甚至有点善良。
但是，这个人的性格古怪，还是少接触为妙。
就在楚生要离开的时候，一只玉手掐住楚生肩膀，让其动弹不得。
“姑娘，你这又是什么意思？”
肩膀吃痛，楚生寒声道。
“死变态，你这烤肉不错，给我烤点来吃！”
女子语气从容，却是不容反驳，道，
“如今天色已晚，雷渊秘境之中，夜间之时，妖兽更加活跃，你再乱走，莫不是找死！”
楚生余光瞥向地上的签子，上面还有残留的肉渣，不禁一阵无奈。
早知道这玩意儿还能成为自己离开的隐患，就应该把它舔干净。
女子见到楚生的眼神，面色一阵转变，心中隐隐期待起来。
独自进入雷渊秘境许久，都是靠气血和丹药，才让自己不饿。
content_en:
"..."
Chu Sheng looked at the other party's smug eyes, but did not feel the other party's murderous intent.
A man is capable of bending and stretching.
Aren't you just feeling a little wronged?
What a fart!
So, Chu Sheng took a deep breath and said kindly: "Girl, I was wrong!"
"I shouldn't take off my clothes anywhere. Is this okay for you to watch?"
The woman then lowered her legs and said proudly: "That's pretty much it!"
"Looking at your sincerity, I will reluctantly forgive you!"
"So, can I get dressed?"
Chu Sheng whispered, his tone full of dissatisfaction.
The woman ignored him and walked to the fire and sat down.
Chu Sheng was alone in his clothes and looked very humble.
Then, Chu Sheng returned to the fire and said dissatisfiedly: "Girl, are you not planning to leave?"
The woman raised her head and looked at Chu Sheng with her watery eyes, suddenly very cute.
If he hadn't been beaten to a bloody pulp by the opponent's move, he would really have been confused by the opponent's appearance.
Seeing Chu Sheng's cold face, the woman threw a jade bottle in her hand and said arrogantly: "You pervert, didn't I just beat you up?"
"Can you, a grown man, stop being so stingy?"
"This bottle of elixir is enough to restore your vitality and blood. Just consider it as my apology!"
Chu Sheng took the jade bottle and opened the lid, and a scent of elixir burst out, making people's blood boil.
Third-grade elixir, blood-restoring elixir!
Chu Sheng grinned and said, "Thank you, girl. How about you give me another beating?"
The woman looked disgusted and said: "Are the disciples of Qingyun College so spineless?"
"Spine, can you use it as food?"
Chu Sheng retorted, "Besides, do you really plan to stay here with me?"
"Does this place belong to you?"
The woman's momentum did not diminish, and she suddenly regained her fighting stance.
Chu Sheng shrank his shoulders and said, "Forget it, I'll give you this place!"
"If you don't leave, I will!"
After Chu Sheng said that, he turned around.
Although this woman has no murderous intentions towards him, she is even a little kind.
However, since this person has a weird personality, it is better to have less contact with him.
Just when Chu Sheng was about to leave, a jade hand pinched Chu Sheng's shoulder, preventing him from moving.
"Girl, what do you mean?"
His shoulder hurt, Chu Sheng said in a cold voice.
"Pervert, your barbecue is pretty good, bake some for me!"
The woman's tone was calm, but there was no room for refutation, and she said,
"It's getting late now. In the secret realm of Leiyuan, monsters are more active at night. If you keep wandering around, you are seeking death!"
Chu Sheng glanced at the sign on the ground out of the corner of his eye. There was still meat residue on it, and he couldn't help but feel helpless.
If I had known that this thing could become a hidden danger for me to leave, I should have licked it clean.
When the woman saw Chu Sheng's eyes, her expression suddenly changed, and she felt a sense of anticipation in her heart.
After entering the Leiyuan Secret Realm alone for a long time, I relied on Qi, blood and elixirs to keep me from being hungry.
